title: Beat 282 - Return
description: A woman in a dark coat and red scarf stands on flooded ornate steps, holding a suitcase marked G#696 and a ticket. She looks back over her shoulder in a grand decaying hall where a yellow train waits at a submerged platform, surrounded by floating film strips, photographs and water lilies.
prompt: A solitary woman in a long dark coat and bright red scarf stands on water-covered marble steps inside a decaying ornate hall, holding a worn suitcase labeled G#696 and a small white ticket. She glances back toward the viewer. Behind her, a yellow passenger train waits at a flooded platform visible through large arched windows with red and yellow curtains. Water lilies float on the floor, old film strips and photographs drift in the water. Warm wall sconce lighting, cool twilight exterior, cinematic surreal atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
